svg.title: Electrospray ionization
svg.desc: Original schematic cutaway for Biotechnology LECT04, image_043. A positive capillary with red electrical lead sprays violet droplets containing yellow sample particles into the evaporation chamber. Successively smaller positively marked droplets release yellow particles that pass through an open slot in the negative collector wall. A top N2 gas tube and separate dark collector lead preserve the source topology. Apparatus proportions and particle counts are illustrative, not measured.
